question: Using only Institutional Characteristics, which has better academic counseling services in 2024-25: Smith College or Mount Holyoke College?

answer.message: I can’t answer the original question reliably from the supplied sources inspected. The 2024-25 Institutional Characteristics data have one item on this topic: whether an institution offers academic/career counseling services (yes, implied no, not reported, or not applicable). It says nothing about how good, how well-staffed or how well-used the service is. So these data cannot show whether Smith College or Mount Holyoke College has better academic counseling. At most they could show whether each college reports offering the service, which is a different question. I can look that up if you want, but it would not rank the two colleges on quality.
